data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 暴雨学园天台的逆风审视
data.description: 暴风雨即将降临的私立学园天台铁丝网前，铅云低垂，闪电划破长空。身穿黑水手制服的雾枝迎风伫立，长发狂舞，回眸冷冷俯视凡人，高贵而危险。
data.location: school rooftop balcony against dark storm clouds and distant lightning flashes
data.action: standing near chainlink fence against gusting pre-storm wind, school uniform skirt flaring, looking back over shoulder with piercing predatory red eyes
data.lighting: 乌云背光与雷暴天际闪光
data.promptProse: Kirie stands on an overcast academy rooftop as storm winds whip her black uniform, glancing over her shoulder with piercing, predatory red eyes.
data.animaCaption: Lightning illuminates the dark thunderheads behind her as the pre-storm wind whips her black uniform. Diffused storm light reveals her face and the rooftop fence.
